rationale: The description says the software analyzes spend/procurement information and recommends savings, risk, and efficiency opportunities as an alternative to analyst review. Such recommendations may be conventional analytics or AI; no method is specified, so non-AI is the best-supported forced choice.
evidence_spans: It can provide recommendations for cost savings, risk exposure, and other efficiency gaps.
The software serves as an alternative to compiling data in an app such as Excel or Tableau and having a team of analysts comb through the information themselves.
conflict_response: The proposals agree on a weak non-AI label, which is appropriate for the right textual reason: recommendations and automated analysis are method-unspecified and could be conventional or AI. The explicit comparison to analyst-driven spreadsheet/BI work gives conventional analytics context, but does not resolve the method enough to upgrade support.
